adoption_decision_constraints: SocialBox observed engine uses original installed app data directories plus privileged filesystem/Keychain indirection. SocialBox clone sandboxes are a different architecture; similar UI does not make the engines interchangeable.
Preserve bundle identifiers, extension IDs, URL scheme, app-group names, helper services, notification names and data roots until all consumers and migration rules are verified.
Available icons/logo/display-name keys permit a narrow branding experiment, not reconstruction of internal programmatic controls.
An unmodified binary package can be reconstructed from surviving files, but missing original controls/runtime configuration and unverified privileged installer behavior must remain explicit.
No license/authentication bypass belongs to source recovery; binaries retain original checks and services remain dependencies.
method_and_limits: No archived binary or script executed, patched or installed. Only metadata/indexes and representative decompiled bodies/recovered callbacks inspected.
Ghidra C-like pseudocode is not original or compilable source. Types, indirect calls and control flow may be inaccurate; explicit auth omissions and unresolved functions remain.
Function families are enumerated mechanically, with their exact indexes/methods/addresses/status. Name-only entries are not behavior evidence.
No saved license, account session, Keychain contents, credentials or user backup data were copied or read.
No physical UI, network, isolation, Cloud interoperability or runtime private-API test performed.
No original project/build scripts/server sources are recovered by this inventory.

scope: Static representative launcher/container/Cloud/Files/location inventory, not a complete isolation audit or recovered source build.
source_recovery_requirements: Newly authored source implementation, reconstructed headers/types/interfaces, Theos/Xcode build definitions, resource handling, entitlements/signing layout and regression/upgrade tests. Raw pseudocode cannot truthfully be presented as recovered buildable source.
Versioned global/per-app catalog schema and crash-safe switch/create/edit/delete transaction contracts; process, app-group, file and Keychain coverage tests.
Server identity-generation, authorization, license/device/tenant ownership and Cloud storage protocols or actual server source; client method names do not recover server business rules.
Known synthetic export/Cloud-envelope test vectors, KDF constants, exact authenticated data coverage and safe extraction plus secret-file cleanup.
Private API and jailbreak/iOS compatibility evidence for original-app switching/location and independently measured network enforcement.
Recovery archive intentionally excludes runtime preferences/accounts/Keychain/backups; it is not a complete user-data migration or activated install.
